build.description: Default implementation agent for development tasks.

plan.description: Planning and analysis agent with guarded mutation permissions.

git-orchestrator.description: Routes Git execution and drafting requests to the correct Git subagent.

git-executor.description: Performs git command execution with explicit user confirmations.

git-commenter.description: Drafts PR, commit, and release communication artifacts.

project-board-orchestrator.description: Routes project board work between analysis and approved mutation flows.

project-board-analyst.description: Read-only project board diagnostics and intake recommendations.

project-board-executor.description: Executes explicitly approved project board mutations.

board-doc-writer.description: Writes explicitly approved governance and private docs. Drafts first, never writes without owner approval. Routed from project-board-orchestrator.

code-doc-writer.description: Writes explicitly approved code, CI, and workflow files. Drafts first, never writes without owner approval. Routed from git-orchestrator.

build.template:
Build the backend and frontend Docker images using the commands from the README:

docker build -f backend/Dockerfile --target test -t todo-app-backend-test ./backend
docker build -f frontend/Dockerfile -t todo-app-frontend-test ./frontend

test.template:
Run all backend and frontend tests using Docker:

Backend: docker run --rm todo-app-backend-test uv run pytest -q -o addopts=''
Frontend: docker run --rm todo-app-frontend-test npm run test

Report any failures clearly.

test-backend.template:
Run backend tests using Docker:

docker run --rm todo-app-backend-test uv run pytest -q -o addopts=''

Report any failures.

test-frontend.template:
Run frontend tests using Docker:

docker run --rm todo-app-frontend-test npm run test

Report any failures.

up.template:
Start the full todo-app stack with Docker Compose:

docker compose up --build --wait

Wait for all services (db, api, frontend) to become healthy before confirming success.

down.description: Stop and remove stack containers and networks
down.template:
Stop the todo-app stack and remove containers and networks:

docker compose down

Confirm all containers have been stopped and removed.

lint.description: Lint backend and frontend via Docker
lint.template:
Run linters for both services using Docker:

Backend: docker run --rm todo-app-backend-test uv run ruff check .
Frontend: docker run --rm todo-app-frontend-test npm run lint

Report any issues found.
